tei:div.tei:p: rje sgam po pa'i lo rgyus/

༈ rje btsun gyi sras kyi thu bo nyi ma lta bu rje zla 'od gzhon nu ni/ sngon gyi sems pa me tog zla mdzes/ thub pa'i spyan sngar zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa/ snying rje padma dkar po'i mdo las/ kun dga' bo nga 'das nas ma 'ongs pa'i dus na byang phyogs kyi rgyud chu bo ro h-i ta'i klung 'gram na dge slong 'tsho byed ces bya ba sngon gyi rgyal ba bya ba byas pa/ sangs rgyas brgya stong mang po la bsnyen bskur byas pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/ theg pa chen po la yang dag par bzhugs pa/ skye bo mang po la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir zhugs pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod 'dzin pa/ theg pa chen po'i bsngags pa brjod pa/ theg pa chen po yang dag par ston pa zhig 'byung bar 'gyur te/ zhes sogs rgyas par lung gis bstan to// de yang da lta gtsang po 'di rgya gar du bab yod cing 'di la brahma pu tra ste tshangs pa'i bu dang chu bo ro hi ta zer ba yin/ de zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yang gaṅgā sogs ni chu stod zla ba ma gtogs par dus kun tu kha dog sngon por gnas zhing chu bo 'di ni dus kun du kha dog dmar por 'bab pa'i phyir de skad zer ba yin zhes yod do/ /bod rnams kyis mdo rgyud kyi gzhung tshig stod smad la rdzun phal ka bsgrigs nas bcos pa'i lung brdzus dang mi 'dra ba'i lung bstan 'dir ni/ byang phyogs shes dang*/ chu bo ro hi ti'i klung 'gram zhes dang*/ 'tsho byed ces dang*/ theg pa chen po yang dag par ston zhes rje 'di 'khrul med du lung gis bstan pa yin 'dug cing*/ 'khrungs yul ni gnyal bud nya'i bye brag ser lung*/ de nyid kyis yab mes kyis brtsegs pa'i gnas gzhi ser kha yod pa de yin/ gdung rus rnyi ba/ yab rnyi ba rgyal po dang yum nga la bza' tshe lcam dag la sras gsum 'khrungs pa'i bar ma yin/ sa mo lugs la bltams/ mtshan dar ma grags su btags/ dgung lo sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi bar rten khyim pa/

sman gyi 'gro don kho na mdzad/ sman pa bi dzi sogs sman gyi slob dpon sum cu bsten/ yan lag brgyad pa rtsa 'grel la mkhas/ de dus da rung g.yu thog pas dpal ldan rgyud bzhi brtsam ma tshar/ slob ma'ang zhang nag dang grum pa lha rje sogs mang du byung*/ de skabs kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen sha ra ba sogs bsten thos pa legs par mdzad pa zhig ste/ jo mo dang sras kun grongs nas dwags por byon/ mang yul ba blo ldan shes rab kyis mkhan po dang*/ zhang zhung pa shes rab snying po bya bas las slob byas/ rje mi la'i slob ma yid bde ba byang sems bya bas gsang ston byas te tshig rdzogs su bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan bsod nams rin chen du gsol/ mkhan slob gnyis las 'dul ba legs par bslab/ mkhan po las zangs dkar lugs kyis bde mchog zhus/ bcas pa la srog las gces par bzung bas gar byon yang btsun pa'i dper 'dren/ byang chub sems dpas gdams ngag zhig btab byung bas zhag bdun bdun tsam ting nge 'dzin la 'byams 'gro ba byung*/ sad de mnyam par gzhag pas zhag bcu gsum tsam du mi g.yo bar gnas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bde bas 'dod yon la blo mi 'jug pa byung*/ de nas dbur stod du byon/ der dge ba'i bshes gnyen smyug rum pa'i spyan sngar bzhugs nas lam rim zla ba dgu bskyangs pasakun rdzob byang chub kyi sems thugs la 'khrungs/ dge bshes rgya lcags ri ba la man ngag mang du gsan/ mgon po gri gug ma zhal gzigs/ dge bshes rgya yon dag gi rtsar byon jo bo'i man ngag thams cad gsan/ de nas nyams len kho na gtso che bar go nas/ se ra kha'i lha khang du bzhugs nas pha zhing la yon bdag byas nas bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin bzang po skyes/ der mdo sde sa bcu pa nas bshad pa'i sa bcu thob pa'i snga ltas kyi rmi lam rnams rmis/ de nas nam zla dpyid dus zhig la mtshams thon te skyo bsang la byon pas/ sprang po gsum gyi gcig na re/

'o skol gsum 'dra ba'i bsod nams chung ba yod pa/ tshol ma dgos par zan chen po dang lo ma'i tshod ma phor pa re btung rgyu yod na zer/ gcig na re yid smon byed na de 'dras gar phyin/ mnga' bdag rtse lde la byed pa yin mod zer/ gcig na re rtse lde la'ang 'chi ba 'ong*/ byed rang byed na mi la ras pa la byed pa yin mod/ lus la gos mi dgos/ 'tsho ba mkha' 'gro mas 'dren pa/ mkha' la bya bzhin 'phur/ skye 'chi med pa de yin na dga' mo zer shugs ring nar nar/ mchi ma rtsig rtsig 'dug der sngar nas dad pa'i kha la lhag par 'gro 'dod pa byung*/ sprang po la ston mo byin/ bla ma rnams la gnang ba zhus/ de'i nub mo dkon mchog la mchod pa phul gsol ba btab pas/ rmang lam na rag dung ring mo zhig bus pas dzambu gling thams cad du grags pa dang*/ deng sang dbus gtsang na 'di bas skad che ba med byas pa zhig rmis/ yang nam mkha' rten med la rnga bo che zhig 'dug pa brdung bas sgra chen po byung de la ri dwags mang pos nyan 'dug pa/ mi mang po 'dug pa la/ mon mo lta bu zhig gis mi 'di rnams la rnga brdung*/ ri dwags 'di tsho la 'di byin zer nas 'o ma thod phor gang gtad/ 'dis 'di tsam mi khyed byas pas/ khyod rang 'thung dang 'dir ma zad rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la thob 'ong zer/ bla ma rnams kyis zangs nged kyis mgar/ zangs skad mis 'don pa zhig 'ong bar 'dug gsungs/ de nas 'gong ston bya ba yul phyogs pa zhig yod pa de lam grogs su khrid de la stod phyogs su gtad de byon/ seng slob zer bar mgo tshad kyis bsnyun te 'chi ba la thug pa zhig byung*/ gtsang gi tshong 'dus 'gur mor 'gong ston na nas lus/ ras pa zhig dang thug pas/ bla mas khyod la gdams ngag myur du ston par 'dug /bla ma'i zhal nas da gzod dbus pa ston pa gcig gis 'gro ba mang po phan pa yod gsung gin snang zer ba gsan pa dang*/

spra bde bkra shis sgang du bud med rgan pa ras gos kyi steng du ske rag slod de ba bcings pa zhig dang 'phrad pas de na re/ do nub slebs sa med nga'i khang pa'i steng du bzhugs zer ste bsnyen bkur byas nas/ nga khar sang bla ma'i drung du phyin pas/ dbus nas bka' gdams kyi ston pa gcig mjal du 'ong gi de'i mjal sna sus byas pa de ngan song gi 'jigs pa med ces gsungs/ nga'i bu mo sgom ma zhig yod pa de la mjal sna 'chol ba yin zer bas khong bas mkhyen lugs kyis bdag skal ldan zhig yin 'dug snyam pa'i thugs rgyal cung zad skyes pa bla mas mkhyen te zla phyed du mjal kha ma btang*/ de nas bla ma pha bong zhig gi steng na bzhugs pa mjal/ gser zho bzhi dang ja zho gang phyag rten du phul bas/ zhal nas gser dang ban rgan lo rus mi mthun/ ja bskol ba'i thab spyad med/ khyod rang gi chos rgyags kyis gsungs/ ming ci gsungs pas/ bsod nams rin chen lags zhus pas/ bsod nams tshogs chen bsags las byung*// 'gro ba kun gyi rin po che// bya ba lan gsum gsungs/ chang thod phor gang gsol zhing 'dug pa gnang ba lhag med du gsol/ sna len gyi mgur ma zhig gsungs/ khyod kyis dbang khrid 'dra e thob gsungs pas/ dge bshes mar yul ba la bde dgyes gsang gsum dang bdag med ma phag mo gzhung drug gi dbang bskur thob/ bdag la zhag bcu gsum la mi g.yo ba'i ting 'dzin bzang po yod zhus pas/ ha ha gsungs nas bzhad mo chen po mdzad/ de rnams kyang yag po yin mod khams gong ma'i 'bras bu tsam thob srid/ lar bye ma btsir bas mar khu mi 'byung*/ til 'tshir na 'ong ba yin/ nga'i gtum mo a 'thung 'di bsgom dang sang da tshod tsam sems kyi ngo bo mthong nas 'ong gi lar bod kyi snying la 'dre zhugs te/ a ti sha la sngags 'chad du ma bcug mi mang po phung zhes gsungs/ me long sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i byin rlabs dang*/

dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dbang dang*/ bsre 'pho gnad kyi man ngag sogs stsal/ bsgom pas yun thung ngu nas rtsa rlung gi drod rtags shar/ lcam lhan cig skyes pa'i sgron ma dpe gnyer mdzad pas chos 'di dang 'di zhes khung bstan pas rje btsun gyis dbang dang gdams pa thams cad bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang*/ de nas rtags mtshan du ma byung ba rnams rim par zhus pas/ rtsa 'di dang 'dir rlung zhugs pa'i rtags tsam yin gyi bzang ngan gang yang min gsungs/ de nas mthar sman bla mched bdun zhal mjal/ longs sku'i zhing khams rab 'byams rnams mthong shākya thub pa dang sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis mjal bas bla ma la zhus pas da ni yi dam lha'i zhal mthong steng longs sprul gnyis dngos su mthong*/ chos sku da gzod mjal bar 'dug gi da dbus su song la bsgom gsungs nas/ bu ston pa dbus su bzhud mi bzhud/ /ces sogs kyi rdzong mgur gsungs/ shar sgam po gdar gyi ri bo ni/ /ri rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra/ /sogs dang*/ ri de yi mgul du gdul bya yod/ /khyod de ru song la 'gro don bsgrub/ /zhes sogs lung bstan mang po mdzad/ bu khyod kyi ming yang dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa 'dzam gling grags pa zhes bya ba yin no gsungs/ de ltar rje btsun gyi drung du zla ba bcu gsum bzhugs nas dbus su phebs/ rje btsun gyis skyel thung gnang*/ me lcags gcig dang a ru ra gser mdog gcig gnang gdams ngag 'di la bsten nas nga la nyams myong khyad par can 'khrungs pa yin gsungs te/ rlung sems dbyer med kyi khrid mdzad de lugs gnyis kyi zhal ta mang du stsal/ bu khyod yos dang rta'i mtshams la brin dang snye nam gyi ri la sleb par gyis shig gsungs nas/ bu spros bral sems la shar dus su sogs gsungs/ de nas rje btsun yar phebs nas/ mdangs bdag gi rmi lam la kho bo'i gnas nas bya rgod zhig 'phur song*/

ri chen po zhig gi rtser bab der ngang pa mang pos 'dus ngang pa re la ngang pa lnga brgya res bskor te phyogs thams cad du 'phur song bas lung pa thams cad ser nyog ste song ba rmis/ kho bo rnal 'byol pa yin pa la/ rjes 'jug rab byung mang por 'ong bar 'dug gsungs so// de nas rje nyid dbus su phebs/ dge bshes smyug rum pa dang mjal/ khyod la rnal 'byor pa'i yon tan ci yod gsungs pas/ rlung phyi nang du mi rgyu/ rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam zhus pas khyod la yon tan bzang po skyes 'dug 'gro don gyis gsungs pas bdag tshe med pa zhus pas tshe'i gdams pa sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i gdams pa gnang*/ de nas lo drug tu bka' gdams pa'i khrod du tshud/ bya cha chos spyod la g.yengs pas sngar gyi ting 'dzin de stor bas/ sngar rje btsun gyis/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom dus su// lus ngag dge sbyor ma brtson cig/ mi rtog ye shes yal dogs yod// gsungs pa dran te rtse gcig tu bsgom pas rje btsun mdun du yer gyis byon pa'i snang ba byung*/ de nas lo drug tu gnyal se ba lung du bsgoms pas drod dang ting 'dzin klong du chud/ phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs bcos min du gzigs nas rtogs pa'i mgur bzhengs/ bo dhi tse'i phreng rdog nyer gcig yod pa phyag gis glang ma'i sdong po zhig la bsdoms te/ nga rgyal bas lung bstan pa yin na shing 'di la shing 'di skye bar gyur cig gsungs pa'i mod la yal 'dab dang bcas pa 'khrungs pas bka' gdams pa'i btsun pa rnams bya cha chos spyod mi byed zhu ba'i skur pa sangs/ de skabs bla ma'i bka' bzhin gser zho bcu gnyis bsnams nas la stod du chas pa na/ yar lung gi mdar sleb tsam na/ gtsang nas 'ong ba'i tshong pa dang 'phrad de rje btsun rta zla'i tshes bcu bzhir chos dbyings su gshegs zer nas phyag 'khar dang na bza'i ras zhig mchod pa'i rten du bskur 'dug pa yang gtad pa'i mod pa bshum bzhin dran med du brgyal ba/

zhal ras la chu phul nas sangs par byas/ gser rnams brin snye nam phyogs su mchod par mdzad do// de nas sho sgom byang yes bya ba de phyags phyir 'brangs der thugs g.yengs ches pas 'ol kar phebs/ ri khrod du lo bdun bzhugs/ phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa sgom med du na 'phar/ der yang zang zing gi 'du longs che nas dbyar 'o de gung rgyal gyi gangs la bzhugs skabs/ yar lha shams po mdun du byung ste/ khyed 'dir bzhugs na'ang ngas yon bdag byed pa yin te/ nga yi bu dwags lha sgam po can du bzhud cing*/ khos khyod kyi zhabs phyi byed par 'gyur ro zer/ de nas bdag lha sgam por phebs/ bla mas lung bstan pa'i gnas su mkhyen/ lo bcu gnyis su 'dag sbyar dgongs/ zangs lung du 'jag spyil bzos/ chu'i bcud len mdzad dgongs nas len du btang tsa na/ ras sgom ras pas chu ga na'ang mi 'dug zer/ khar sang bsdad pa'i brag rtsa'i stan chung de sol dang gsungs pas/ bltas pas chu mig zhig rdol 'dug go /der bud med lus la thal ba byugs pa lag na rma bya'i sgro bzung ba zhig gis/ bcu gnyis 'dag sbyar dgos pa chung*/ /bcu gnyis bstan pa spel na mchog zer/ de nas zhag kha shas nas/ gtsang gi klog skya ston pa byung*/ de nas rgyal ba khyung tshang pa/ dge bshes gnyen nag gnyags dmar po rnams pa rim par byung*/ de rnams la khrid tshar ba dang dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi snod dang ldan pa'i mi rnams dus gcig la 'dus pa lta bur tshogs/ gdams ngag btab pas ring por ma lon par nyams myong khyad par can rtsa rlung gi yon tan mngon par shes pa drug ka dus gcig la shar ba dpag tu med pa byung*/ de thams cad ma dag pa'i dngos po mi 'chang zhing sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis sogs la gnas pa sha stag ste/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ skyes bu dam pa mya ngan yongs 'das nas// ma rungs dus na bdag gis mdo 'di gzung*// de yi tshe na ting 'dzin dag pa dag/

lnga brgya las ni mi nyung der 'byung te// mdo sde mchog 'di rgya cher gzung ba la// de dag sngon du 'dren pa gzhon nu yin// zhes gsungs pas byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas la ma 'ongs pa'i dus na mdo sde zab mo 'dzin pa la smon lam btab pa de rnams so/ /mdo 'di ni sgyu ma lta bu/ dpa' bar 'gro ba/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin rnams zhib mor bstan pas shānti pa'i shes phyin gyi man ngag dang/ dbu ma rgyan 'grel las kyang zhib par gsungs shing/ rje sa paṇa gyis sems tsam rnam med pa'i bsgom la phyag rgya chen por btags pa zhes gsungs shing rje chos kyi dbang phyug sogs kyis gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi rgyal po zhes don gcig tu bzhed pa nyid do// grub pa brnyes pa'i rdzu 'phrul ni mtha' yas kyang kha shas smos na/ yon bdag dgyer 'bum can du rab gnas nyi ma gsum la mdzad cing*/ nye gnas 'ga' re'i snang ngor dwags po'i sgom khang du 'dag sbyar smra bcad mdzad nas bzhugs pa dang*/ nye gnas 'ga' zhig gis ni bshad sgrub spel mar mdzad pa mthong ba dang*/ yang 'brog khyi rdzi'i 'khrug pa sdum par phebs pas sgom chen pa sngon la btang nas rje nyid 'ja'i lam nas phebs te 'khrug pa sdum pa dang*/ nang zho bur 'dren 'ongs pa'i tshe zad par sa dang chu dang me dang nam mkha'i sprul bsgyur dang*/ yon bdag dar rgyal la mchod rten du sprul pa dang*/ sku la grib ma med pa dang*/ nam mkha'i lam nas gshegs pa dang skyil krung du bzhugs pa dang*/ phug pa cher ma song ba'i nang du sku dwags lha sgam po'i ri tsam mdzad pa dang/ sgom pa sher gzhon gyis spyan drangs par kho pa ber phyam khur du sngon du song ba'i'ang sngon du phebs zin pa dang*/ yang rtse 'byung gnas ye shes kyis spyan drangs nas der pheb pa dang gzim khang du btsun chung gcig la chos ston pa'i sku'i bkod pa gnyis mdzad pa dang*/

'gar la bde mchog bcu gsum ma'i dbang mdzad pas bde mchog tu sprul pa dang*/ byang chen mchod rten ri tsam tu sprul te gzim chung mi lnga shong bar tshud pa dang*/ lus snang sems gsum gcig tu 'dren pas ka ba la phyag ma thogs pa dang*/ gtsang por 'ding ba bting ste chu gzhung du pheb pa dang*/ bdud rtsi thab sbyor gyi phyag rgya mdzad pas sku bdun nas grangs med par du sprul pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro 'bum sder chos gsungs pa sogs 'byams su klas so/ /dge bshes bya yul ba dang chos gsan res mdzad/ dge bshes khyung tshang bas btsun sar 'di rnams la dang po 'dul mdo'i 'chad nyan re byed mi stsal par dang po nas sgom rgyag tu gnang ba 'di ci yin bsam pas/ de nub rmang lam tu sgam po ri lung thams cad brag phug gis gang ba'i nang du mchod rten bzo legs par rdzogs pa nas gzugs dod tsam yan gyis khengs par lha dang bcas pas mchod pa rmis pas/ rje yis khyod kyis nga'i btsun chung 'di kun brnyes pa chen po byed kyang khyod kyis rmi lam du byung ba de ka yin gsungs/ ra rdzi ras pas mtshan thos pa tsam dang/ rgya sgom rdor seng gis zhal mjal ba tsam gyis sgom skyes/ nya ston dang sho sgom gnyis chos zhur phyin pas lam du rtogs pa 'khrungs pa dang*/ yar 'brog mar yul bya bas bsnyen rdzogs byas bsgom zhus pa chos mgo ma thon khyim par gyur ba zhig mtshan mor bsgoms pas spur la ring bsrel phyur ba sogs bshad kyis mi langs pa kho nar snang ngo*/ /skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpar zhal gyis bzhes pa ste/ ting rgyal las/

ye shes bla med 'di ni rab bsgrubs nas// phyi dus mod la de ni 'jig rten du// rgyal ba dri med 'od zhes bya bar gyur// zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa bdag gnyis kyis// lung bstan 'di thos dga' ba rgyas 'gyur te// zhes dang/ snying rje pad dkar las/ byang chub sems dpar byed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po rnam pa sna tshogs bsags nas 'chi ba'i dus byas ma thag tu nub phyogs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba brgya stong 'das pa na de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag tu med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur te/ 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhes bya bar de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i 'od zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo dge slong 'tsho byed de'ang nga'i bstan pa 'di yangs shing rgyas par byed par 'gyur gyi/ kun dga' bo khyod mya ngan ma byed cig /ces gsungs so// skabs der khams pa mi gsum gyis dam rdzas cung zad zhig bzhes pas nyams 'ur/ de dge bskos kyis thos nas khong gsum gnas dbyung bas/ sgam po'i lha mchod thams cad dbu zhabs ldog /rjes ci yin gsungs pas/ rgyu mtshan gsol ba na/ khong gsum mi 'dug phyin nga'ang sdod dgos med gsungs nas drwa chung rgyab tu bsnams/ spa mkhar phyag tu bzung ste phebs pas dgon gsham pha bong gi khar bla mas bro 'khrab ste sho mo yar shog ma gsungs pas zhabs rjes mang du byon/ khong gsum pha bong 'og ma'i khar bro 'khrab ste yar 'ong zhus par yang zhabs rjes mang po byon/ der lo bcu gnyis 'gro don mdzad/ bdun bcu rtsa lnga la gshegs/ nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis khengs shel gyi mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad kun gyis mjal ba'i mthun snang grub/ thugs ljags ring bsrel sogs mang du byon no// ༈¿¿slob ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa las/ dngos kyi gdan sa pa sgom po tshul khrims snying po 'di rje nyid dang dgongs pa mnyam/

lha sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag rmang nas gsos/ byang chub sems dpar shar phyogs sku 'khrungs pa sogs rgyal po bka' 'chems las lung gis bstan/ de la dwags po khu dbon zhes su grags/ sho sgom 'phags pa/ zim ye shes snying po/ gser sgom ye shes snying po/ chos g.yung ste grub thob bzhi/ gdan sa pa dbon sgom tshul khrims snying po de dang*/ dus gsum mkhyen pa/ phag mo gru pa/ 'ba' rom pa rnams ni brgyud 'dzin gyi bu bzhi/ dwags po 'dul 'dzin/ 'gar sgom dkar po/ lho la yag pa/ kye bo ye shes rdo rje ste nyes ba'i sras bzhi/ rmog cog pa/ sgom chung*/ grol sgom chos g.yung*/ gsal stong sgom sho ste thugs sras bzhi/ jo stan gsal byang*/ gsal me ste nye gnas bzhi/ gnyags nag po dang rdzi sgom sogs mtha' yas par byon no// ༈¿¿'ba' rom pa dar ma dbang phyug ni/ chos rje'i chibs kha ba mdzad/ nyin mtshan dbyer med kyi sgyu lus 'byangs/ de'i thugs sras ti shri ras pa dang slob brgyud sgom sde nang ya gnyis sogs 'ba' ram bka' brgyud sgom sde ri khag bco brgyad rnams byung*/ sgom tshul gyi slob ma zhang tshal pa ni rga lo'i slob ma yang yin mod dbon sgom pa las ye shes brnyes/ gung thang gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ chos blon 'gar gyi gdung dpon chen dar ma soḍa tshal pa'i khri dpon rnams byung zhing tshal pa bka' brgyud du grags pa de byung ba'o// ༈¿¿rje karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bka' brgyud kyi rnam thar ni phyi nas rgyas par 'chad pa las shes shing*/ ༈¿¿dpal phag mo gru pa ni/ mdo khams rme shod kyi sab khang du 'khrungs/ bya 'dul las bsnyen par rdzogs/ sa skya pa chen po las lam 'bras sogs zhus kyang sems kyi de kho na nyid ma rtogs pas rje dwags po rin po che dang mjal bas phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes ji bzhin gzigs/ phag mo grur dgon pa mdzad de bzhugs/ ༈¿¿'gro mgon smar pa yang mkhas grub tu re ba zhig yin yang*/

rje 'di'i byin rlabs zhugs te ye shes brnyes/ gtsang du byon na phrin las nyid dang mnyam par lung bstan khams su sho dgon btab/ smar pa bka' brgyud zhes pa'i rgyun las deng sang dpal yul bar grags pa 'di byung 'dug/ ༈¿¿'gro mgon yel pa yang thugs dam dpyis phyin par re ba zhig yin par dbu ma phar phyin gsang sngags thams cad bsgom dgos pa yin pas/ sgoms shig gsungs pas gnas lugs mngon du gyur te bstod phyag mdzad/ de nas shar rdo rdzong lho yel phug byang rta rna rnams btab/ yel ba bka' brgyud zhes pa byung snang*/ ༈¿¿skyu ra rin po che ni/ mdo khams 'bri klung gi yul tsar stod rtsi dur 'khrungs/ rje phag mo gru pa bsten/ phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes brnyes dpal mgon klu sgrub kyi sprul par grags/ slob ma yang spyan snga rin po che dang gnyos mgar chos gsum sogs mtha' yas pa byung zhing mkhan chen gu ra ba dang dbon rin po che sogs 'bri khung bka' brgyud zhes pa 'di byung ba yin no// ༈¿¿rje skyob pa'i slob ma spyan snga rin po ches thel gyi gdan sa mdzad pa nas phag gru bka' brgyud zhes pa 'di byung ba yin/ ༈¿¿stag lung thang pa mdo khams g.yang shod bong ra steng du ga zi'i gdung du 'khrungs/ rje phag mo gru pa bsten snying po'i don gzigs/ mos gus mthar phyin stag lung pa zhes grags/ de nas sku yal ba sogs stag lung bka' brgyud zhes pa 'di byung ba yin/ ༈¿¿za ra ba skal ldan ye shes seṅge ni/ mon 'gar du 'khrungs/ rje 'di'i zhal mjal nas ngo sprod btab pa tsam gyis rtogs pa 'khrungs shing*/ de'i slob ma g.yam bzang chos rje ni dang po bka' gdams pa mdzad/ za ra ba mjal tsam gyis rtogs pa bzang po 'khrungs/ 'di las g.yam bzang bka' brgyud zhes pa de byung ba'o// ༈¿¿gyer sgom chen po ni/ yar klung du 'khrungs/ rnal 'byor chos g.yung nas chos rdzogs/ rje 'di las rtogs pa'i ye shes brnyes nyi phu shug gseb btab ste shug gseb bka' brgyud ces pa de byung ngo*//

༈¿¿rgyal tsha rin mgon ni/ bla ma brgya dang bcu gsum bsten/ rje phag mo gru pa las rtogs pa'i ye shes brnyes/ khro phu btab khro phu lo tsā sogs khro phu bka' brgyud zhes pa byung ngo*// ༈¿¿grub thob gling ras ni/ khyung tshang pa dang rgyal ba lo sogs bsten mthar phag gru dang mjal/ thugs la btags/ chu bo gaṅgā tshun du rtogs pa mtho bar grags/ de'i slob ma gtsang pa rgya ras ni/ gyad klu dga'i mi brgyud la 'khrungs/ grub thob gling ras dang mjal bas ye shes brnyes/ rje dus mkhyen gyis lung bstan nas 'brug sgrub gnas mdzad pas dpal ldan 'brug pa zhes mtshan thog mar chags/ de la'ang rgod tshang pa soḍa stod 'brug / dbon ras sogs bar 'brug /lo ras sogs smad 'brug tu grags pa mi phyed 'brug pa zhes pas grub thob kyi tshang chen po rdol pa 'di ka byung ba'o// ༈¿¿rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal lho mon du phebs nas mon pa tsho bzhi sogs ting nge mdzin gyis dbang du bsdus nas spong klog gi 'dus sde mang po btsugs te/ lho 'brug ces lugs gnyis kyi mnga' thang la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa 'di dang*/ dwags la sgam por yang mnyam med dwags po rin po che khu dbon gyi seṅge'i khri skyong ba'i gdan rabs dang zur khyad can gyi chos sde dang bcas byung zhing*/ kaṃ tshang rang gi nang khul du'ang zur mang bka' brgyud dang gnas mdo pa'i bka' brgyud sogs phyi nas 'chad 'gyur gyi chos brgyud rkang tshugs pa 'ga' yang byung zhing dar rgyas su bzhugs so// // dar rgyas 'phel/ gu ṇas zhus so//
